about_the_game:
Step into a world overrun by the infected.

In this action-packed zombie FPS, you'll fight your way through relentless hordes using a wide variety of weapons and tactics. With intense gunplay, atmospheric environments, and fast-paced gameplay, this game delivers a thrilling survival experience for fans of the undead genre.

"Protect The Hangar : From Zombies" is a survival-focused FPS zombie game. You play as a soldier tasked with defending an abandoned hangar from endless waves of the undead. Fight to survive using a variety of weapons and limited resources.

  • Realistic gun mechanics

  • Wave-based enemy system

  • Ammo, health, and armor pickups for resource management

  • intense sound effects and horror elements

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent violence and gore involving zombies, including blood effects, dismemberment, and intense combat scenes. While the violence is stylized and focused on action gameplay, it may not be suitable for all audiences. There are no depictions of sexual content, drug use, or other sensitive themes.This game contains mature content that may not be suitable for all audiences. It features frequent violence, blood, and gore as part of the zombie survival gameplay. Players use firearms to eliminate zombie threats in dark and intense environments.The game does not include any sexual acts, nudity, or references to non-consensual activity, drug/alcohol abuse, BDSM, or self-harm.Please be advised that the overall atmosphere and combat visuals may be disturbing to sensitive players.
